name: Ichimoku Cloud Strategy - EURUSD
description: Classic Ichimoku Cloud trading strategy using Tenkan-sen/Kijun-sen crossovers with cloud confirmation for EURUSD forex pair
source:
# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Ichimoku Cloud indicator
tenkan, kijun, senkou_a, senkou_b, chikou = ichimoku(timeframe=1D)()

# Cloud conditions
price_above_cloud = close > senkou_a and close > senkou_b
price_below_cloud = close < senkou_a and close < senkou_b

# Crossover signals
tenkan_cross_above_kijun = crossover(tenkan, kijun)
tenkan_cross_below_kijun = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)

# Entry signals
long_entry = price_above_cloud and tenkan_cross_above_kijun
short_entry = price_below_cloud and tenkan_cross_below_kijun

# Exit signals
long_exit = tenkan_cross_below_kijun or price_below_cloud
short_exit = tenkan_cross_above_kijun or price_above_cloud

# Hold positions using hold_until
long_signal = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=long_exit)
short_signal = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=short_exit)

# Position execution
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_signal, short_entry=short_signal)

# Default position sizing
position_size(type="percent")(size=100)

# Event markers
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Long Entry",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Tenkan", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Kijun", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Entry Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(close, tenkan, kijun, long_entry)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Short Entry",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Tenkan", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Kijun", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Entry Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True)
        ]
    )
)(close, tenkan, kijun, short_entry)
